svg.title: HIcosmo Software Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram for HIcosmo: JAX-based cosmological parameter estimation framework.
svg.text: Software Architecture — JAX-based Cosmological Parameter Estimation Framework
Fig. 1. Software architecture of HIcosmo. The high-level API dispatches to cosmological models and likelihood functions, which feed into MCMC
samplers or Fisher forecasting modules. Results are rendered through a unified visualization interface, all built on the JAX backend.
